Name: Joe T. Garcia's
Address: 2201 N Commerce St, Fort Worth, TX 76106
Description: A Fort Worth institution since 1935, this family-owned Mexican restaurant is famous for its massive outdoor patio and margaritas. It's the kind of place every local has a memory tied to.

Name: Fort Worth Botanic Garden
Address: 3220 Botanic Garden Blvd, Fort Worth, TX 76107
Description: The oldest botanic garden in Texas with over 2,500 plant species across 23 specialty gardens. The Japanese Garden section is especially peaceful in the spring.

Name: Kimbell Art Museum
Address: 3333 Camp Bowie Blvd, Fort Worth, TX 76107
Description: One of the finest small art museums in the world, housed in a stunning Louis Kahn building. Admission to the permanent collection is always free.

Name: Sundance Square
Description: The vibrant heart of downtown Fort Worth — 35 blocks of shops, restaurants, and live music. The open-air plaza hosts free community events year-round.

Name: Fort Worth Water Gardens
Description: A remarkable urban park with dramatic terraced waterfalls designed by Philip Johnson. The active pool you can walk down into is an unforgettable experience.
